decisive_items: located especially on the malar and preauricular areas
with a diameter of 5 to 10 mm
response.rationale: Atrophic symmetric facial lesions without induration or epidermal changes, with dermal fibrosis and elastic fiber loss, best fit atrophoderma of Pasini and Pierini; follicular atrophoderma lacks follicular involvement.

rejected.why: No follicular mucin or follicular involvement described.
Lupus erythematosus typically shows epidermal changes and induration, absent here.
Dermatomyositis requires muscle weakness and characteristic rash, not present.
Sarcoidosis would show granulomas, not mentioned.
Erythema elevatum diutinum is nodular and inflammatory, not atrophic.
Follicular atrophoderma requires follicular involvement, absent.
Discoid lupus has epidermal changes and induration, contradicted.
Lichen sclerosus typically shows sclerosis and epidermal atrophy, not induration here.
